title: webpack-dev-server vulnerable to cross-origin WebSocket access via proxied upgrades
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-112085 affects webpack-dev-server version 3.0, allowing cross-origin WebSocket access via proxied upgrades. This issue relates to improper handling of WebSocket upgrade requests that could enable unauthorized cross-origin access. No CVSS score is provided, and there is no indication of known exploits in the wild. No patch or remediation details are currently available.
